description: This file is a PHP unit testing class for the CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPI within the OrangeHRM recruitment API module. It contains test methods for API endpoints such as getOne, getValidationRuleForGetOne, update, delete, and getValidationRuleForDelete, focusing on the CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPI class functionality.

classes.name: CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPITest
classes.description: A test class extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase to contain multiple test cases for the CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPI class, including tests for getOne, getValidationRuleForGetOne, update, delete, and their respective validation rule methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by truncating CandidateHistory table.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the getOne method of CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPI, expects NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests the validation rule retrieval for getOne, expects NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the update functionality of the API with various test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testUpdate method, loading data from 'MarkInterviewPassedTestCases.yaml'.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the delete method of CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPI, expects NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests the validation rule retrieval for delete, expects NotImplementedException.
